alex: Quick ask — we need a compact battlecard row and two bench hooks for next week's webinar vs cloud-managed endpoints + LLM APIs. Keep SDR lines < 12 words.

priya: For SDR opens: 1) "How do you avoid surprise inference bills?" 2) "Do you have SLA-backed tail metrics?" 3) "Want a quick cost model for your workload?"

nate: Bench hooks (short): cost: "30% lower token spend on batch jobs via continuous batching+quantization." latency: "p99 cut from ~1.1s to ~360ms using smart routing+KV cache."

cory: Battlecard row: ""Operational lift": Cloud X = low start, high ops at scale; Redwood = small setup, predictable ops. Keep it one line.

sdr-bot: upload: https://drive.redwood/bench/3740012345/sample_traces.csv (auto)

alex: Good. Add 2-line rebuttal to "we use cloud X": "Sizing up avoids spikes but raises costs; we optimize serving so you don't overprovision. Plus, we layer on your model choices — no migration."

priya: Webinar hook: open with a retail spike vignette -> show cost vs time + p99 waterfall -> CTA: "See a tail-trace for your app."

nate: I'll drop the two one-paragraph bench notes into /marketing/bench-briefs tonight. Cory, can you sketch the slide? Need by Wed noon.

cory: On it. Method note: 5k traces, synthetic peak, compare naive endpoint vs continuous batching.

alex: Timeline: finalize battlecard + SDR script by Wed EOD, deck by Thu. Playtest with 4 SDRs Friday morning. Thanks.
